Question: Company History
Answer:
Mr. J.P. Sharma started a firm in 1984 named AKASH Engineering Works which used to manufacture spares for Hindustan National Glass (HNG).
1996 to 2009 supplied few spares to Everest like gear hub.
2009 to 2015 manufactured complete blowers for Blowvacc
In 2015 started our branding AKASH and 100% production for A1 Blowers done side by side till Sept. 2018.
From 2018 to till date we are doing 100% production for self only.
